ideas.title: The Rise of DOJ Investigations into Public Officials
ideas.description: This story would investigate the trend of DOJ investigations into public officials, including the recent investigation into Walz and Frey.
ideas.angle: The story would examine the potential motivations behind the increased scrutiny of public officials and the implications for accountability and transparency in government.
questions: What are the motivations behind the increased scrutiny of public officials?
What are the implications for accountability and transparency in government?
ideas.insight: As an investigator, I believe that this story has the potential to shed light on important issues related to accountability and transparency in government. By examining the trend of DOJ investigations into public officials, we can gain a better understanding of the complexities of corruption and the need for effective oversight.
